target.title: fix(control-ui): show unavailable sizes for negative byte counts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Control UI status details could render an invalid negative byte count as a normal byte-size value, such as -1 B, instead of showing the existing unavailable marker.

## Why This Change Was Made

 ormatBytes() is the Control UI wrapper that decides when byte-size data is displayable. Missing and non-finite values already render as -; this change treats negative byte counts the same way because byte counts are cardinal values and a negative count is not a meaningful UI size.

The shared  ormatByteSize() helper remains unchanged. It still formats caller-provided numbers with the requested unit style; the Control UI wrapper now rejects this invalid display input before delegating to that shared formatter. Existing zero and positive formatting remains unchanged.

## User Impact

Users now see - for malformed or sentinel-like negative byte metrics instead of a misleading negative size label. Normal Control UI byte displays such as  B, 512 B, and 1.5 KB are preserved.

## Evidence

After-fix terminal proof from the current branch source. The temporary local script reads ui/src/lib/agents/display.ts, evaluates the exported  ormatBytes() function body, and imports the real shared formatter from packages/normalization-core/src/format.ts:

`	ext
Control UI byte formatter after-fix proof (current branch source)
formatBytes source: ui/src/lib/agents/display.ts
formatByteSize source: packages/normalization-core/src/format.ts
guard line: if (bytes == null || !Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) {
formatBytes(-1): -
formatBytes(0): 0 B
formatBytes(512): 512 B
formatBytes(1536): 1.5 KB`

Focused regression coverage added:
-  ormatBytes(-1) returns -
- existing zero and positive byte formatting assertions remain unchanged

Validation:
- git diff --check passed
- pnpm --dir ui test -- src/lib/agents/display.test.ts was attempted locally, but the command ran the full UI suite and hit local environment failures unrelated to this diff: Chinese locale-formatted strings, missing Playwright Chromium, and a pre-existing Vite alias assertion. No production files outside ui/src/lib/agents/display.ts and ui/src/lib/agents/display.test.ts were changed.

AI-assisted: drafted and validated with Codex; I reviewed the change and understand the behavior.
